recommendation_for_brief.design: Matched independently seeded production replicas for each declared fixed Asp state; preserve same selected pose/chemistry/register/FF/water/salt/temp and aligned analysis; compare replica/block estimates, not60000independentframes. Include multiple starting poses as a separate later variable.
recommendation_for_brief.number_of_replicas: Existing2 perstate exploratory. Atleast3 matched100ns replicas pergenotype/state; prefer4 whenreplicavarianceislarge. Full100ns/late50ns/10nsblock reporting; use replica asunit, treat4siteswithinreplicaascorrelated. Extension driven byprecision/sampling diagnosis, not fixedclaimthat3or4converges.
recommendation_for_brief.protonation: ASH274 denotes protonatedAsp274, not a mutation. Protonate correspondingAsp in allfour sites as declared, preserve neutralbetaNH2, regeneratecharges/counterions; fixedchargeMD cannot exchangeprotons or determine pKa/equilibriumacidstate.
recommendation_for_brief.acceptance_reporting: Report TierA, positivephi and nativeThr gates separately, each perreplica and production block. Neither TierA fraction nor confidence is catalyticactivity, proton-transfer evidence or a barrier.
recommendation_for_brief.limitations: ASH274 1677+0 frames vsASP/ASP37+238 andASH2723886+1724 does not establishcausality orbeneficialacidassignment. NewandlegacyFF datasets use different poses/protocols; do notpool them. Mature substratehydrolysis is separatefromautocleavage.
recommendation_for_brief.Asp_geometry: For everyoneof4active sites use chemicallylabel-invariant minimum of4AspO-O distances: OD1-OD1,OD1-OD2,OD2-OD1,OD2-OD2. Do not average4sites asindependentreplicas.
